description: Flat metadata schema for individual buffer solutions used in protein crystallography crystallization experiments, capturing composition, pH, batch/lot traceability, and supplier information.

buffer_id.descr: Unique identifier for the buffer solution record used in a crystallization trial.

buffer_name.descr: Common or laboratory name of the buffer solution, e.g., 'Tris-HCl pH 8.0' or 'PBS'.

buffer_composition.descr: Text description of the full buffer composition, including all components and their concentrations, e.g., '50 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl'.

buffer_pH.descr: Measured or target pH of the buffer at the temperature of preparation; report as a numeric value, e.g., 7.5.

buffer_temperature_for_pH.descr: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the pH was measured or adjusted, if known, e.g., 20.0.

buffer_batch_number.descr: Manufacturer batch or lot number for the buffer solution or key buffer component used in the experiment.

buffer_supplier.descr: Name of the supplier, vendor, or manufacturer of the buffer solution or its prepared components.

buffer_catalog_number.descr: Supplier catalog or product number associated with the buffer solution or reagent components.

buffer_preparation_method.descr: Description of how the buffer was obtained or prepared, e.g., 'commercially purchased', 'prepared in-house', or 'diluted from stock'.

buffer_preparation_date.descr: Date when the buffer was prepared, reconstituted, or received, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

buffer_concentration.descr: Overall buffer concentration, if applicable, reported in mol/L or mM as specified in the composition description.

buffer_concentration_units.descr: Units for buffer concentration, e.g., 'mM', 'M', or 'mg/mL'.

buffer_solvent.descr: Primary solvent used to prepare the buffer, typically 'water' or specified aqueous solution.

buffer_sterile_filtered.descr: Indicates whether the buffer was sterile-filtered before use.

buffer_storage_condition.descr: Storage conditions for the buffer, e.g., '4 C', '-20 C', 'room temperature', protected from light.

buffer_expiration_date.descr: Expiration or recommended use-by date of the buffer, if available, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

buffer_notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to buffer quality, special handling, or deviations from standard preparation.
